# Planetz Roller

Planetz Roller is a colorful, soft-toned theme with a flat, painted look across the whole Obsidian interface. Its recorded description aims at a gentle palette and smooth flat elements throughout the workspace.

![Planetz Roller screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monoooki/obsidian-planetz-roller-theme/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Planetz Roller"
    author: "monoooki"
    repo:   "monoooki/obsidian-planetz-roller-theme"
    slug:   "planetz-roller"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/planetz-roller"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/monoooki/obsidian-planetz-roller-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monoooki/obsidian-planetz-roller-theme/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a colorful, soft-toned theme with a flat, painted look across the entire Obsidian interface. Give Obsidian a cohesive, gentle palette and smooth flat elements for a calm, playful workspace."
}
```
